title: Notice regarding non-availability of Hon'ble Ms. Justice S.V.Pinto on 06.11.2026.
text:

FULL TEXT:
The High Court of Gujarat
Ahmedabad
Date: -03/11/2026
N O T I C E
HCG-03/2026
It is hereby notified that on 06.11.2026;
1. Hon’ble Ms. Justice S.V.Pinto would not be available.
2. Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble Mr. Justice Vimal K. Vyas)
would take up the matters notified in the Cause list of
Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble Ms. Justice S.V.Pinto.)
By Order of Hon’ble The Acting Chief Justice
Sd/-
Registrar (Judicial)
